Quick plan:
1) Would you prefer a short poll (2 mins) where you check the best slot, or should I propose two concrete options and lock one? I can do either.
2) If procurement needs a short control/security intro, my manager Marissa can join for the first 10 minutes to cover compliance and audit logs.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Feb 25, 9:30am (30m)
- Thu Feb 26, 1:00pm (30m)

I attached a small calendar file with those two options (suggested-times.ics). If one of those is good, reply "Lock Wed 25 9:30" (or Thu) and I'll send an updated invite. If you'd rather we run the poll, I'll send a one-question Doodle and give you a 24-hour window.

Also, quick ask for procurement: if you have any preferred contract terms or an internal DocuSign routing address, drop that here so we can prep.

Thanks — Nikhil
